prompts: Read MarketingHub/workspace/data.json. Then: 1) compare my keyword rankings against the previous scan, 2) tell me concretely which opportunity tags to add to the iOS keywords field / Play description (give me the updated text), 3) flag notable changes in competitor metrics, 4) give one single-sentence priority for next week.

Refresh the ASO keyword research for {app}. Research the titles and subtitles of the competitors currently ranking on the App Store and Google Play for these clusters: {kws}. Compare them with my current metadata and propose an updated 100-character set for the iOS keywords field. Flag any new cluster that is gaining volume.

Produce store copy for {app} in [LANGUAGE]. This is NOT a translation — do separate keyword research: use the terms people actually search in that language, keep the brand name intact, invent nothing. Character limits: title 30, subtitle 30, iOS keywords 100 (comma-separated, no spaces), Play short 80, long 4000. Return it in the localization schema used in workspace/advisor.json.

Write {ns} screenshot band headings for {app} in [LANGUAGE], each at most 5 words, all-caps energy. Use the same vocabulary as the store copy so coverage reinforces itself. Give 2 alternatives per heading.

Write 3 short-video concepts for {app} (15-25s, vertical). Here is the footage I have: [DESCRIBE FOOTAGE]. For each concept give: the hook (what is on screen in the first 2 seconds), the flow, on-screen text, an audio suggestion, and a caption + hashtag set. Goal: viewers comment.

Fetch the current store pages for {app} ({stores}) from the web and audit them: do the title/subtitle/descriptions match the suggestions in the panel, are the character limits used well, is any visibility signal leaking? Give me a diff list ordered by priority.

Research the current news around these terms: {brands}. Is there an upcoming launch, remake, news story or viral trend? If so, produce a content plan and promo-text suggestion for {app} for that week; if not, say "no wave" and suggest the next check date.

This week's store data: impressions [X], page views [Y], installs [Z]. Last week: [X2/Y2/Z2]. From this: where is the bottleneck (visibility or conversion), what should I focus on, and what are 3 concrete actions for next week?

briefs.trailer:
=== STORE TRAILER BRIEF — {app} ===
GOAL: Store page conversion (iOS App Preview + Play video)
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical · 15-30s · minimal text overlay · must read with sound off

SHOT LIST (real screen capture — record at 60fps):
1. (0-3s)  STRONGEST MOMENT: [the product's most striking 3 seconds] — NO logo/intro
2. (3-8s)  core loop: [what the user actually does, shown fast]
3. (8-13s) variety: [different screens/modes/themes]
4. (13-18s) depth: [progression, collection, personalisation]
5. (18-25s) peak: [best score / best result screen]
6. (last 3s) logo + "Download Now" + store badges

AI HOOK (Veo/Runway/Pika/Kling — write the prompt in English):
"[cinematic scene describing the product's core idea], vertical 9:16, 3 seconds, high energy"
Use the AI shot as the OPENING hook only; the remaining 90% must be real capture
(fake gameplay/product footage is a penalty risk on ad networks).

EDIT: beat-synced cuts · max 1.5s per cut · movement in the first frame
MUSIC: royalty-free/licensed
OUTPUTS: 1080x1920 (store) + 1920x1080 (YouTube)
TARGET KEYWORDS: {kws}
briefs.ugc:
=== UGC / TESTIMONIAL BRIEF — {app} ===
GOAL: Organic reach in the discovery feed · trigger comments
FORMAT: 9:16 · 15-25s · handheld feel · SUBTITLES REQUIRED (80%+ watch muted)

SCRIPT A "confession": "[your build story in one sentence]" → show the product →
"...then [what you fixed]. Look what happened."

SCRIPT B "reaction": hand holding the phone + real usage, natural reaction at the peak

SCRIPT C "before/after": "[before: the old/rival way]" → "[after: your product]"

AI SUPPORT: multiply the same hook with 5 different opening lines; test different
narrator variants with AI-UGC avatar tools.
CAPTION: [one sentence + name in the comments] · RULE: it must not look like an ad.
briefs.satisfying:
=== SATISFYING / DETAIL BRIEF — {app} ===
GOAL: ride the "oddly satisfying" trend · watchable muted · loopable
FORMAT: 9:16 · 10-18s · SOUND DESIGN IS CRITICAL

MATERIAL: [the product's most satisfying micro-moment — animation, transition, completion]
5-6 repetitions back to back; also capture one uninterrupted single-take variant.

EDIT: every hit lands on a music beat · last frame = first frame for the loop
AUDIO: dry "punch" + light reverb; minimal music
TEXT: one line, question format (drives comments)
MEASURE: target 80%+ watch time; if the first 3 videos miss, change the sound design.
briefs.wave:
=== TREND WAVE BRIEF — {app} ===
GOAL: be ready for a topic whose search volume is about to spike
WATCHED TERMS: {brands}
FORMAT: 9:16 · 20-30s · emotional opening + product demo

STRUCTURE:
1. (0-4s) the visual language of the moment: [the wave's aesthetic — era, event, trend]
2. (4-7s) bridge line: [one sentence connecting the viewer from the topic to the product]
3. (7-20s) HARD CUT → product: [your 3 strongest moments]
4. (20-25s) closing claim + logo + store badges

TIMING: have it ready to publish the day the news breaks (produce it IN ADVANCE).
CAUTION: never use someone else's brand name in AD copy (trademark) — implication is enough.
TARGET KEYWORDS: {kws}
